purpose: Teach: 集結/論評/開館/取り込む/愛称/利率/換金/代弁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、全社員を本社に集結させろ
lines.en: Gather all staff at headquarters immediately.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Rapid-fire delivery. No softening. Each phrase lands like a directive. Breath stays controlled and efficient.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の論評がメディアで好意的です
lines.en: Yes. The media response to the new product has been quite positive.
lines.style: Steady, attentive cadence. Slight emphasis on positive. Posture is upright—reporting clearly but not over-explaining. Tone is professional, neither excited nor flat.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新支店の開館を急げ
lines.en: Accelerate the opening of the new branch.
lines.style: Direct, measured command. Weight on accelerate. Still composed but with underlying urgency. Eyes forward. No room for questions—this is priority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様のご要望を社内で取り込む計画です
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to incorporate customer feedback into our internal strategy.
lines.style: Clear, methodical. Matching his tempo but with slightly warmer inflection—showing the plan is thoughtful. Pause before 'internal strategy' to signal this is solid work. Respectful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品の愛称を募集しろ
lines.en: Start recruiting suggestions for the new product's brand name.
lines.style: Sharp, efficient instruction. 'Start' opens with clean attack. Tone is matter-of-fact, brisk. No elaboration needed—the task is simple and the expectation is clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への利率優遇を案内します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also communicate the preferential rate terms to our valued clients.
lines.style: Confident, responsive. Slight beat before 'also' to show initiative beyond what was asked. Warm but professional. Not rushed—this is capability showing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外取引の換金手数料を見直せ
lines.en: Review the foreign exchange fees on overseas transactions.
lines.style: Measured, economical phrasing. Steady weight on review. Composed but with precision—this is a financial detail that matters. No rushed breath, just clear intention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の声を経営陣に代弁いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure our team's input reaches the management level.
lines.style: Warm close. Respectful but assured—he's committing to follow through. Tone settles slightly, showing understanding of what matters. Breath is steady, genuine. Professional reliability.
